name: HealthCo Healthcare and Wellness REIT
summary: HealthCo Healthcare & Wellness REIT (HCW) is a Real Estate Investment Trust listed on the ASX focused on owning asset for like NOI growth. HCW has a strong reinstate distribution and drive healthcare and wellness property assets. The REIT's objective is to provide exposure to a diversified portfolio underpinned by healthcare sector megatrends, targeting stable and growing distributions, long positive environmental and social impact. HCW also Sciences Fund. HealthCo Healthcare and Wellness REIT was incorporated on July 30th, 2021 in Australia.
